Start with the flow

Everything on the page follows the same slow curve of attention.

02

Show the structure

A good rail says where you are before you have to look for it.

03

Let motion explain

Speed is information: a fast scroll should look different from a slow one.

04

Keep it physical

Lag, stretch and snap-back make a plain bar feel like a material.

05

Finish quietly

The tail catches up and the page settles into stillness.
